thread:
Jules (Accounts Payable): Heads upNexGen Labs invoice INV-4482 for $9,750 got rejected by Coupa. Reason: NO_PO on header + bill-to matches legacy entity. PDF: https://drive.redwood.internal/drive/9pQ/inv-4482.pdf

invoices-bot: Routing failure detected: approver group for cost center 4300 inactive (approval-service v2.3.1)

Nina (Procurement): Which PO should this hit? I searched contracts and saw SOW references PO-7122 but status = ARCHIVED (closed last quarter). Archived/closed POs don't accept new invoices in our flow.

Jules (Accounts Payable): Also the invoice uses "Redwood Labs" instead of "Redwood Inference - Corp". Coupa fuzzy-match failed because of that and the missing PO. Two reasons for reject.

Tara (Vendor Ops): I'll ping NexGen and request a corrected invoice: add PO=PO-7122 (if procurement approves) and exact remit "Redwood Inference - Corp". Sending template now. If vendor can't update, we can run a retro approval but that needs a PO reconciliation note.

Maya (Finance): Vendor-first preferred for audit trail. @Nina can procurement either reopen PO-7122 for invoice acceptance or create a short-term PO?

Nina (Procurement): Reopen possible but needs approval from PO owner; reopening takes ~24-48h. Alternative: issue one-off PO-9555 for this invoice-only payment. Which is faster?

Jules (Accounts Payable): If vendor reissues with PO and correct bill-to we can auto-match same day. Manual/retro approval path typically adds 1 business day + additional approvers.

invoices-bot: Created ticket AP-10123 (manual approval fallback) assigned to Accounts Payable. Link: https://ap.redwood.internal/ticket/AP-10123

Tara (Vendor Ops): NexGen replied: they can reissue but asked if PO-7122 is still valid given archive status. Asked for exact bill-to string and remit address. I sent the template and asked them to reference INV-4482 in subject.

Maya (Finance): Thanks. Next steps: (1) @Tara get corrected invoice with PO-7122 and bill-to exact; (2) @Nina decide reopen vs temp PO and confirm; (3) @Jules hold payment until either corrected invoice arrives or AP-10123 approved.
